shots.composition_other: three-phase: centered phone mockup cropped at bottom, then free-floating source chips scattered left of frame in 3D space, then a full-width dashboard card
shots.focal_element: The source chips (reddit, Verywellfit, NY Times, Vogue) lifted out of an AI answer and carried into a citation ranking table
shots.transition_other: entry not visible in the 2 fps sheet; at the first sampled frame (0:54.0) the phone mockup is already rising from the bottom edge
on_screen_text: Who makes the best yoga pants for under $100?
Here are some great yoga pants under $100, with a mix of affordability, comfort, and performance:
shots.typography: Clean UI sans (Inter-like, low-confidence guess); question in medium weight sentence case, body regular; source chips small medium-weight labels in rounded pills; dashboard title semibold sentence case, table text small regular with default tracking.
shots.what_happens: A dark-mode phone mockup showing an AI answer to a yoga-pants question slides up into view (w146-w149); the camera then tilts and the four source pills detach from the answer and float in 3D with depth-of-field blur while the phone recedes (w150-w156); the pills drift and converge, then dissolve into their matching rows of a 'Citation Page Count' table on a Nike industry-analysis dashboard, whose horizontal mention bars grow in (w157-w169). Several table domain names and numbers are too small to read at this resolution and are not transcribed.
shots.build_rebuild: Render the phone answer card, animate its source pills to translateZ/rotate in a perspective container with per-pill blur by depth, then FLIP-tween each pill onto its row position in a dashboard table while staggering bar widths from 0 to value.

shots.focal_element: A single soft grey horizontal band across a near-black frame
shots.what_happens: A two-frame interstitial: a blurred grey horizontal bar on dark, apparently the edge of the dashboard card mid-move between the table view and the chart view (w169-w170).
shots.build_rebuild: Insert a 2-frame motion-blurred slice of the next card's edge as a bridge frame between two dashboard views.

shots.focal_element: A green line drawing across the 'Industry Mention Volume' chart with a black value tooltip riding its tip
shots.transition_other: opens on a tight crop of the chart and pulls back to reveal the full dashboard card
shots.typography: UI sans (Inter-like, low-confidence guess); breadcrumb and filters small regular; section titles semibold sentence case; axis labels small uppercase month abbreviations; tooltip value bold white numerals in a small black badge.
shots.what_happens: Starting close on the chart, the camera pulls out to show the full Nike dashboard card while the green mention-volume line draws on from the left and its tooltip counts up (12 to 28 across the sampled frames); in the second half the camera tilts and pushes into the chart in steep perspective with soft focus, following the line tip (w170-w179).
shots.build_rebuild: Animate an SVG path stroke-dashoffset to draw the line while a tooltip follows the path end and counts up its integer, wrapped in a 3D camera that pulls out then rotates X/Y and pushes in with a depth blur.

shots.composition_other: tilted light card bleeding off the right and bottom edges, title top-left
shots.focal_element: The highlighted Nike row climbing to position 1 in the brand ranking list
shots.typography: Light-mode UI sans (Inter-like, low-confidence guess); card title medium weight sentence case; brand names regular title case with circular logo avatars; rank numerals light grey regular.
shots.what_happens: The palette flips to light mode: a tilted 'Industry Mention Volume' ranking card shows Nike at rank 5; the Nike row, outlined as a raised glass pill, slides up past Patagonia and The North Face and its rank reads 1 (w180-w187); the shot ends on an extreme defocused close-up of the Nike swoosh as the camera rushes in.
shots.build_rebuild: Render a perspective-tilted list, give the Nike row an elevated pill style, tween its translateY to the top slot while siblings shift down and its rank number swaps 5 to 1, then scale the swoosh toward camera with increasing blur.

shots.what_happens: A two-frame blurred light-grey frame with darker vignetted edges, apparently the inside of the out-of-focus swoosh at the end of the zoom, bridging into the brand graph (w188).
shots.build_rebuild: Hold a 2-frame heavily blurred white fill at the peak of the zoom as a whiteout bridge into the next scene.

shots.focal_element: The Nike logo node at the centre of a network of competitor brand logo nodes
shots.what_happens: A large, blurred Nike swoosh disc racks into focus and pulls back to reveal a dark node graph of circular brand logos (lululemon, adidas, asics, FILA, Columbia, Under Armour and others) linked by thin lines, drifting with depth-of-field and slight chromatic fringing (w189-w200); in the last sampled frame a red-orange light leak washes across the right side as the graph keeps pulling out. Logo wordmarks only; no typeset text.
shots.build_rebuild: Place logo discs at varied Z in a 3D scene connected by thin line segments, start the camera near the Nike disc with strong blur, then dolly back with depth-of-field, add RGB split on out-of-focus nodes and fade in a warm light-leak overlay at the end.
